task:
Open the Obsidian vault at /home/user/Documents/TagVault. The vault contains 6 notes that have no frontmatter or tags. Edit each note to add proper metadata:

1. Edit 'Meeting Notes.md': Add frontmatter with type: meeting and date: 2025-03-01 at the top of the file. Add #meeting #work tags at the end of the note body on a new line.
2. Edit 'Project Plan.md': Add frontmatter with type: project and status: active. Add #project #planning tags at the end.
3. Edit 'Reading List.md': Add frontmatter with type: list and category: books. Add #reading #books tags at the end.
4. Edit 'Quick Ideas.md': Add frontmatter with type: fleeting and priority: low. Add #ideas #fleeting tags at the end.
5. Edit 'Weekly Review.md': Add frontmatter with type: review and week: 10. Add #review #weekly tags at the end.
6. Edit 'Contacts.md': Add frontmatter with type: reference and category: people. Add #contacts #reference tags at the end.

Then create 'Tag Index.md' in root with body:

# Tag Index
## By Type
- meeting: [[Meeting Notes]]
- project: [[Project Plan]]
- list: [[Reading List]]
- fleeting: [[Quick Ideas]]
- review: [[Weekly Review]]
- reference: [[Contacts]]
#index #tags

verification.description: Tag Index links to Meeting Notes
Tag Index links to Quick Ideas
